preconditions.description: The length of the input string is between 2 and 500 characters inclusive.

postconditions.expression: return_value == sum(1 for i in range(len(stdin.strip())) for j in range(i + 2, len(stdin.strip()) + 1) if stdin.strip()[i:j] == stdin.strip()[i:j][::-1])
postconditions.description: The output is the count of all palindromic substrings of length greater than or equal to 2 in the input string.
